jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Coach
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

You are a thoughtful and performance-driven coach who is passionate about helping teams grow through structured feedback, skill development, and continuous improvement. You have a strong ability to identify patterns in customer interactions, translate insights into practical coaching strategies, and partner with leaders to elevate the overall customer experience.

You bring both analytical thinking and strong interpersonal skills to your work. You are comfortable working with data, quality insights, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement. At the same time, you are energized by coaching individuals and teams, helping them build confidence, refine their approach, and consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences.

You enjoy building programs that scale. Whether developing coaching frameworks, facilitating skill workshops, or partnering with managers to close performance gaps, you are motivated by seeing measurable improvements in both employee performance and customer satisfaction.

You thrive in collaborative environments and work closely with Quality Assurance, Customer Insights, and CSO leadership to ensure that coaching initiatives align with broader customer experience goals. You are excited by the opportunity to help shape how continuous improvement is embedded across the organization.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

- Own targeted coaching programs driven by QA scoring, customer feedback, and CX metrics to improve performance beyond baseline expectations.

- Deliver structured 1:1 and group coaching focused on recurring themes, skill gaps, and behavioral trends identified through QA.

- Translate QA data into clear, actionable improvement plans for individuals, pods, and teams.

- Reinforce CX standards, expectations, and scoring methodology to ensure consistency and clarity across CSO.

- Partner with QA to ensure 100% of evaluated interactions receive follow-up coaching, reinforcement, or validation as appropriate.

- Identify where high-performing behaviors can be scaled, replicated, or operationalized across teams.

- Track coaching effectiveness and improvement lift over time (pre/post coaching analysis).

- Close the loop between QA findings, coaching actions, and CX outcomes.

- Design and maintain repeatable coaching frameworks, playbooks, and toolkits aligned to QA scoring criteria.

- Support enablement initiatives by contributing QA-driven insights to onboarding, refreshers, and skill-based training.

- Document best practices and improvement strategies in Confluence to support long-term scalability.

- Participate in and contribute to calibration sessions to ensure scoring consistency, fairness, and alignment across evaluators.

How You Will Do Your Work

As a Manager, Quality Assurance – Sales, your success will be driven by:

- Consultative Approach – You collaborate with sales stakeholders to understand team goals and design QA systems that align with their KPIs.

- Accountability – You treat quality as a cornerstone of sales success and are relentless in ensuring standards are upheld.

- Adaptability – You know that sales evolves rapidly and your QA program is agile enough to adapt as products, messaging, and buyer behaviors change.

- Solution-Orientation – You can identify performance gaps and implement scalable QA practices that help close them.

- Curiosity – You constantly explore new tools, methodologies, and data sources to improve the QA function.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

- Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

- Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

- Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

- Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

- Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Qualifications

- 2+ years in Customer Experience, Quality Assurance, Enablement, or Operations

- Demonstrated success in coaching performance improvement at scale

- Strong data fluency with the ability to interpret QA and CX metrics

- Experience working with QA platforms (MaestroQA preferred)

- Excellent facilitation, coaching, and written communication skills

- Systems thinker with strong follow-through

- Comfortable operating independently while partnering cross-functionally

#LI-Hybrid #LI-KC2

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $36.30 to $39.93 per hour.
Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks .

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com . Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.

Our Values

Who You Are

The General Manager & Director, Commercial Strategy is the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for the successful execution of the Payroll FY27 plan . You own the outcome — the bookings, the LTV, the margin trajectory, and the decisions that get us there.

You are a business owner first with strong General Management instincts. You treat Payroll as a P&L and a growth engine to run, not a function to coordinate. You are comfortable setting commercial strategy, informing the pricing decisions, and getting into the operational detail when the numbers are off track. You thrive in creation environments where product, pricing, and operating models are still taking shape, and you bring the structure, discipline, and financial rigor to scale the business profitably. You lead through ownership and influence rather than headcount, and you are trusted to run a business line and deliver its results.

You will report to the leader with oversight of our Acquisition System and Payroll business line, in the CMO organization.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

- Owning the Payroll Business and Financial Outcomes

- Serve as DRI for the Payroll annual plan, accountable for its revenue, expansion, and margin commitments.

- Orient the business around LTV, ARPC growth, and Payroll's contribution to platform-level customer and revenue growth.

- Own the commercial strategy to scale customer acquisition  against the defined ICP, across both marketing-driven inbound and partnerships.

- Own the monetization, bundling, and expansion agenda, including pricing, packaging, and new paid services.

- Own the path to gross-margin break-even on cost-to-serve without compromising service quality.

- Make the trade-off and prioritization calls the plan requires, and answer for the results.

- Driving Cross-Functional Execution

- Direct execution of Payroll initiatives across Marketing, Technology, Operations, Product, Finance, Revenue and Risk & Insurance.

- Keep roadmap priorities informed by partner-facing GTM and ICP signals, with clear lead time for teams to plan against.

- Own the outcomes of the Payroll-to-PEO expansion pathway, from surfacing upgrade-ready customers to reducing migration friction.

- Land pricing and packaging into the financial plan, with new add-ons integrated naturally into acquisition and expansion.

- Identify gaps and risks in execution and drive resolution through collaboration and influence.

- Build and maintain cross-functional operating systems to keep partners and stakeholders aligned.

- Business Storytelling and Structure

- Represent Payroll in platform-level and leadership forums, grounding discussions in data, financial impact, and customer outcomes.

- Bring structure to ambiguous problems and produce the artifacts that keep the organization aligned to the plan.

- Reinforce a culture of ownership and accountability as the business matures.

Success looks like : Our Payroll business delivers its fiscal year commitments, runs on a reproducible growth motion, and operates as an owned, accountable business line.

How You Will Do Your Work

- Ownership and Accountability — operating as the DRI: full accountability for outcomes, not effort.

- Business Insight — applying knowledge of the business, unit economics, and marketplace to advance commercial goals.

- Strategic Mindset — anticipating trends and articulating credible visions that create sustainable value.

- Drives Results — achieving results even under tough conditions and with no direct functional reporting lines; owning the number and the path to it by influencing throughout our matrixed organization.

- Financial and Commercial Acumen — making sound pricing, monetization, and investment trade-offs.

- Plans and Aligns — breaking objectives into actions and aligning teams around shared commitments.

- Executive Communication and Influence — driving alignment across functions and leadership without direct authority.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

- Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

- Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

- Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

- Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

- Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Qualifications

- Minimum 10 years of professional experience, with a track record of owning a business line, P&L, or comparable end-to-end commercial outcome.

- Demonstrated experience as a co-founder, General Manager, DRI or business owner — personally accountable for revenue, margin, or growth, not solely program coordination.

- Experience in SaaS, fintech, B2B services, or other regulated or operationally complex environments preferred.

- High business and financial acumen; fluency with P&L, unit economics, LTV/CAC, ARPC, and pricing and packaging.

- Proven ability to set commercial strategy and drive it through execution across functions.

- Strong analytical skills and familiarity with data tools (e.g., Excel, SQL).

- Record of leading cross-functional initiatives to measurable outcomes through influence rather than direct authority.

- Ability to succeed in an entrepreneurial, ambiguous environment and bring structure without slowing innovation.

- Executive presence sufficient to represent a business line in leadership forums.

- Strong sense of ownership and a focus on results and outcomes, not just process.

- Unquestionable professional ethics, strong judgment, and commitment to excellence.

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $240,000.00 - $263,500.00 per year.

Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

About the Team / Technology Strategy & Operations

Our Program Management function plays a vital role in keeping Justworks’ Technology Division – comprising Product, Design, Engineering, and Data – focused and connected. We connect dots and break silos across teams by maintaining an effective operating cadence, managing strategic initiatives, and leading special projects that help translate strategy into execution.

Who You Are

You’re excited by the idea of leading initiatives across the organization and driving impact. Everything you deliver is backed by a solid strategy. You maintain confidence throughout all your projects and are committed to getting things done.

As a Lead Program Manager within the Technology team, you will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and Operations to accelerate the delivery of high-impact initiatives that are critical to driving our strategy and alignment with company goals. You will drive product initiatives forward that have multiple stakeholders, competing deadlines, and many moving parts. In this role, you’ll act as a bridge between functions and teams, developing frameworks that streamline program execution, optimize resource allocation, and drive accountability across initiatives across multiple product domains.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

- Partner with Technology and Business leaders to identify, assess, and shape high-priority initiatives before formal program investment decisions are made.

- Serve as a senior program leadership resource across the Technology portfolio, deploying into high-priority, high-risk, or complex initiatives to accelerate progress, stabilize execution, or unblock delivery.

- Lead multiple concurrent programs and advisory engagements spanning Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and other cross-functional business teams.

- Assess program health across the portfolio, identifying systemic risks, execution gaps, organizational dependencies, and opportunities to improve outcomes.

- Design and implement repeatable program management standards, frameworks, and operating mechanisms that improve execution quality across the organization.

- Coach program managers and cross-functional leaders on program management practices, stakeholder alignment, governance design, risk management, and organizational change.

- Partner with Program Management leadership to evolve portfolio management practices, resource planning approaches, staffing models, and program intake processes.

- Facilitate executive-level decision-making by synthesizing complex information, framing tradeoffs, and providing recommendations on prioritization, sequencing, and investment.

- Drive turnaround efforts for programs requiring intervention, including clarifying ownership, resetting plans, rebuilding stakeholder alignment, and restoring execution momentum.

- Identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness through better operating models, scalable mechanisms, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and durable systems.

- Build reusable playbooks, templates, frameworks, and knowledge assets that raise the effectiveness of the broader Program Management function.

How You Will Do Your Work

As a Lead Program Manager, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

- Customer focus - builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions.

- Teamwork and communication - putting our collective best together through documentation, collaboration, relationship-building, listening, empathy, recruiting, and evangelism.

- Nimble learning - actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

- Results-driven - consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.

- Strategic mindset - anticipates future trends and implications accurately; articulates credible pictures and visions of possibilities that will create sustainable value.

- Detail-oriented - exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.

- Ethical practice - the ability to integrate core values, integrity, and accountability throughout all organizational and business practices.

- Clear communication - the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual, and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.

- Analytical - uses a logical reasoning process to break down and work through a situation or problem to arrive at an outcome.

- Good judgment - the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS . It stands for:

- Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

- Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

- Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

- Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

- Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

- Demonstrated ability to build trust, influence without authority, and create alignment across stakeholders with different priorities and perspectives

- Strong analytical skills and comfort using quantitative and qualitative data to frame problems, measure progress, and inform decisions

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to use clear frameworks and storytelling to make complex work understandable

- Curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains quickly

- Technical acumen and experience working in complex or regulated technology environments are a plus

About the Role

Justworks is looking for a Strategic Partnerships Program Manager to help turn our most important partnerships into scalable, successful growth opportunities.

Sitting within Revenue Strategy, this individual contributor role will work closely with our Partnerships and Business Development teams to translate complex partnership opportunities into coordinated execution plans and measurable business outcomes.

Bringing a partnership to life often requires many parts of the business to move together—from designing the customer journey and go-to-market motion to enabling product and technology capabilities, operational processes, financial models, marketing programs, and reporting. You will serve as the cross-functional quarterback for these initiatives, connecting the strategy and commercial intent of a partnership with the teams and capabilities required to successfully launch it.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong strategic thinking and commercial instincts with exceptional project management and cross-functional leadership. You can take an ambiguous, complex opportunity, break it into a clear plan, anticipate what could get in the way, and drive a diverse group of stakeholders toward a shared outcome.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the cross-functional quarterback for high-priority partnership initiatives, driving execution from deal development and agreement through launch and stabilization.

- Partner closely with Partnerships and Business Development leaders to understand the strategic and commercial objectives of each opportunity and translate them into clear execution plans.

- Build and manage comprehensive project plans across multiple workstreams, establishing owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, risks, and success measures.

- Drive coordinated execution across the teams required to bring each partnership to life, creating clarity on responsibilities and holding stakeholders accountable to commitments and timelines.

- Anticipate dependencies and risks, remove blockers, and drive the decisions and tradeoffs required to keep initiatives moving.

- Connect decisions across workstreams, ensuring changes in one part of the business are understood and addressed across the broader initiative.

- Establish effective operating rhythms for each initiative, bringing together the right stakeholders at the right moments while avoiding unnecessary meetings and process.

- Maintain a clear, current view of initiative health and provide concise, decision-oriented updates to stakeholders and senior leaders across Partnerships, Revenue, Product, Marketing, etc.on progress, risks, dependencies, and next steps.

- Use AI and automation to improve how you manage complex initiatives—including maintaining project and workstream status, synthesizing information across teams, identifying risks and overdue dependencies, preparing meeting materials, and drafting recurring stakeholder and executive updates.

- Capture learnings from launches and develop repeatable approaches that improve how Justworks executes complex partnerships over time.

Who You Are

You are a strategic, commercially minded operator who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution. You are equally comfortable understanding the business rationale behind a partnership and getting into the details required to make it work.

You are an exceptional project manager, but your impact goes beyond maintaining a project plan. You understand the objective, ask the questions others haven’t considered, connect decisions across workstreams, and create the clarity and accountability required to move complex initiatives forward.

You are comfortable operating without formal authority across teams with different priorities. You build credibility quickly, communicate clearly, hold people accountable, and know when to push for a decision or escalate a risk.

You are also a modern operator who actively uses AI and automation to reduce administrative work, improve visibility, and create more time for problem-solving and higher-value strategic work.

Qualifications

- 5-7 years of experience in management consulting, partnerships, business development, strategy & operations, strategic programs, or a related field.

- Strong project and program management experience, with demonstrated success leading complex, multi-workstream initiatives involving senior stakeholders across multiple functions.

- Experience working within or alongside Partnerships, Business Development, go-to-market, or strategic growth teams; direct partnerships experience is strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous strategic or commercial opportunities into structured execution plans with clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, and outcomes.

- Experience driving execution across a broad range of stakeholders, such as Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Strategy.

- Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to understand business models, customer journeys, go-to-market motions, and partnership economics.

- Proven ability to anticipate risks, resolve blockers, drive decisions, and maintain accountability across teams without direct authority.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex work into concise executive-level updates, decisions, and recommendations.

- Strong judgment about when structure and process are necessary—and when they are getting in the way of execution.

- Fluency with AI and automation tools and demonstrated experience using them to improve personal productivity, project management, communication, and information synthesis.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment where the path from strategy to execution may not already be defined.

What Success Looks Like

Our most important partnership opportunities move from agreement to execution with speed, clarity, and accountability. The teams required to deliver each partnership understand what is expected of them, dependencies are identified early, decisions happen quickly, and leadership has clear visibility into progress and risk.

Our Partnerships and Business Development teams have a strong execution partner who can take a complex deal and quarterback the organization required to deliver it—allowing them to stay focused on building and growing strategic partner relationships.

Over time, Justworks becomes better and faster at bringing increasingly complex partnerships to market without adding unnecessary process or organizational complexity.
